metadata.label: Quaternius / Dance Loop
metadata.purpose: Pose-harvest conditioning from Quaternius / Dance Loop. CC0-1.0. Sparse source poses, not manual substitute targets.

source_harvest.label: Quaternius / Dance Loop
source_harvest.conversion: Bounded direction/foot/torso IK onto native 29-hinge G1. Root orientation including inversion retained; not a faithful lossless skeleton conversion.
source_harvest.sample_policy: Four initial source poses at 30 Hz; a midpoint and final pose become two sequential one-pose target requests. The generated duration is not the source duration.
source_harvest.conversion_limitations: Bounded direction/foot/torso IK onto G1; fingers, contact and human proportions are not preserved.
